question: Should this dashboard status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin now, or should it wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` contract before the issue is considered solved?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep the linked builtin candidate
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution while requiring its proof, storage, security, dependency, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 defines the richer Gateway activity/attention API, then implement the dashboard widget against that contract.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing after preserving this issue's unique status-widget requirements there.

recommendation.title: Keep the linked builtin candidate
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution while requiring its proof, storage, security, dependency, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.
